_comment: SYNTHETIC MINIMUM NETWORK — 3 solve stations + 1 held-out consumer, GPS+Gal data
(the producer arm restricts to GPS via processing.active_systems).
docs/SPEC_synthetic_minimum_network.md.  SMOKE arc: 20 epochs, wiring only.
Geometry: a ~500 km triangle over the central US with the consumer inside it.
Chosen as the longest baselines that keep strong common visibility at a 10 deg
mask; MUST be certified (k = 1 bipartite component at every epoch) before any
graded arm — at 3 stations the hardcoded kMinStationsPerSat = 2 is one station
from binding, and a fragmented epoch makes the rank gate withhold and read as a
producer defect.
Receiver code biases DIFFER per station on purpose.  The Table-8 identity this
fixture exists to test resolves the FLEET MEAN of the receiver GF code bias; a
roster where every station carries the same bias makes the fleet mean
indistinguishable from its members, and the estimator could realize any split
between them and still grade as correct.
Quiet by construction (storm_scale 0) — this is the G-A null arm.  The GIM
background is still a real, spatially varying field sampled at each station's own
pierce point, which is what gives the network genuine between-station ionosphere.
INT posture: corrections.signal_bias is OFF here, so the satellite phase bias is
zero and the P-record test is exact integers x lambda.  The producer arm MUST
match with model_corrections.enable_code_phase_bias = false.  The W6 arm flips
both together.
